speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Ischemic Colitis. The sudden onset of severe abdominal pain combined with bloody, loose bowel movements is highly characteristic of ischemic colitis, a condition where blood flow to part of the large intestine is reduced. While appendicitis and diverticulitis are differentials, the presence of bloody diarrhea points strongly toward the colonic vessels. Given the urgency expressed and the specific symptom cluster, I am confident in this initial assessment based on the clinical presentation provided.
